title: A tautological continuous field of Roe bimodules
summary: We generalize the notion of a continuous field of C*-algebras to that of Hilbert C*-bimodules. Given a partially ordered set $P$ and a monotonically non-decreasing family of ternary rings of operators (TROs) assigned to the points of $P$, we equip $P$ with a certain zero-dimensional Hausdorff topology and use a certain compactification $γP$ to get the base space for a continuous field of Hilbert C*-bimodules over $γP$.
